scope: Source-fidelity requirements from accepted 1847–1850 batches 14–16; one cumulative export remains deferred until research reconciliation.

requirements.requirement: The morning Auckland/Herschel commission is already available when the main body begins. The Owen refusal note arrives only by P5 and must not condition earlier composition. Preserve both missing-input records with their distinct receipt order; one letter date cannot erase that sequence.

requirements.requirement: Keep the newly arrived Fitch letter confined to the reopening at P4. Earlier P1–3 must not be conditioned by that note merely because it occurs in the same source. Preserve the distinct earlier permission for the carina from the new permission request.
requirements.accepted_primary_note: Accepted batch 15; this is a grounding/temporal requirement, not a new graph acceptance.

requirements.requirement: Render Darwin’s thanks separately from physical specimen receipt: the carrier forgot Thursday and was expected Monday at the College. Do not infer that specimens had arrived merely because Darwin expresses gratitude.
